data.name: Vikee
data.gender_notes: Vikee is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vikee is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijay', which means 'victory'. This name is given to a child who is believed to bring victory and success in all aspects of life. It is a powerful and unique name that instills a sense of courage and strength. The name Vikee carries the meaning “Bringer of Victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vikee usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Vikee is believed to invoke the blessings of the Hindu gods and goddesses, particularly Lord Vishnu, who is the preserver of the universe and the giver of success and prosperity.
data.etymology: Vikee belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vikee total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
